data.body_html:
Planning a hen party in Marbella for 2037? A yacht charter is the ultimate way to celebrate, but getting the budget right is key. This breakdown covers boat options from €749 for 2 hours up to €4,719 for a premium 4-hour trip, with all inclusions like skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. Whether you're a group of 5 or 12, we'll help you plan every euro. For more inspiration, check our [Marbella yacht charter](/blog/marbella-yacht-charter-hen-party-budget-breakdown-2037/) guide.

Boat Options and Price Tiers for 2037

Our fleet is divided into two price tiers. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours, rising to €2,299 for 8 hours. These are perfect for intimate groups of 9-11 guests. Tier B (Mangusta 80) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours, including a free jet ski. For larger groups, the Ferretti 94 or Azimut 58 Flybridge are available on request. All depart from Puerto Banús.

What’s Included in the Price?

Every hen party yacht charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees. You can bring your own decorations or food. For premium catering, contact us via WhatsApp. The skipper handles navigation, so you can relax and celebrate.

Extra Costs to Consider

Optional extras can enhance your hen party. Water toys like jet skis or inflatables cost extra (except for the Mangusta 80 which includes a jet ski). Premium catering (e.g., seafood platters, champagne) can be arranged. If you moor overnight at a marina like Estepona or Sotogrande, port taxes apply. These are discussed before booking.

Splitting the Cost Per Person

Hen parties often split the bill. For a Tier A 8-hour charter at €2,299 with 11 guests, it's about €209 per person. A Mangusta 80 at €4,719 for 4 hours with 12 guests is roughly €393 each. This makes luxury affordable. For a smaller group of 5, the Dubhe (€ on request) or Mariah SX21 are budget-friendly options.

Best Boats for a Hen Party of 12

For a group of 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), and Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) are ideal. The Mangusta 80 includes a free jet ski for added fun. All have spacious sun decks for dancing and photos. For a classic party vibe, the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) is a sporty choice.

Booking Tips for 2037

Book 2-3 months in advance for summer weekends. Popular boats like the Mangusta 80 fill fast. Early booking secures your date and allows time to plan extras. Consider a half-day (4 hours) to visit Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, or a full day for lunch at Estepona. Use our [contact page](/blog/marbella-yacht-charter-hen-party-budget-breakdown-2037/) for personalized quotes.

Sample Itineraries on Budget

Budget for 9 guests: Astondoa 40 at €749 for 2 hours (€83/person). Cruise from Puerto Banús to Cala del Faro, swim, and enjoy drinks. Upgrade to 4 hours (€1,499) for a stop at Estepona. For 12 guests on a Mangusta 80 at €4,719 for 4 hours (€393/person), include jet ski rides and a stop at Cabopino.
